responsibility: Server-authored identity carried by an accepted attempt; not a paid execution grant.
legacyPolicy: Only absent envelopes retain the existing explicit-owner user path; present malformed or nonhuman envelopes never fall back.
publicPolicy: Discard reserved identity and attendance fields, then stamp authenticated owner and tenant at command acceptance.
